title: Playing Too: játszik and the Placement of is

sections.content: játszik ('to play') is another -ik verb; its infinitive is játszani. When is ('also/too') modifies an infinitive phrase like this, it comes right after the infinitive, before szeretek.

Compare this with is attached to a noun (like 'A szoknya is szép' from an earlier unit) -- the rule is the same: is sits right after whatever it's adding to the list, here the whole infinitive játszani.
